stories.title: Tien leeuwen in Tanzania dood gevonden na mogelijke vergiftiging

en.title: Ten lions found dead in Tanzania after possible poisoning
en.summary: Ten lions have been discovered dead in Tanzania following suspected ingestion of a toxic substance. Authorities are investigating the incident and attempting to determine responsibility.

stories.title: Tien leeuwen in Tanzania dood gevonden, mogelijk vergiftigd

en.title: Ten lions found dead in Tanzania, possibly poisoned
en.summary: Ten dead lions have been found in Tanzania's Ngorongoro nature reserve. The NCAA authority managing the reserve is conducting investigations into the cause of death and seeking to identify those responsible for the possible poisoning.

stories.title: Trump wil niets weten van zorgen over AI en kondigt ‘AI-force’ aan

en.title: Trump dismisses AI concerns and announces 'AI-force'
en.summary: Trump has rejected worries regarding artificial intelligence and announced the creation of an 'AI-force'.

stories.title: Toekomst bondskanselier Merz op het spel bij Duitse deelstaatverkiezingen

en.title: Future of Chancellor Merz at stake in German state elections
en.summary: Regional elections are underway in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern with potential national political consequences. Chancellor Merz faces pressure following the AfD's strong performance in previous elections and speculation about his political future.

stories.title: Ed Sheeran geeft 'fouten' toe bij eerste concert sinds ophef rond Macklemore

en.title: Ed Sheeran admits to 'mistakes' at first concert since Macklemore controversy
en.summary: Ed Sheeran apologized for the controversy surrounding rapper Macklemore's removal from his tour opening lineup during his first Loop tour performance.

stories.title: Ed Sheeran erkent fouten tijdens eerste concert sinds ophef rond schrappen Macklemore

en.title: Ed Sheeran acknowledges mistakes at first concert since Macklemore removal controversy
en.summary: Ed Sheeran apologized at his first performance following Macklemore's removal from his tour's opening act, stating he made mistakes in the situation and addressing Gaza's humanitarian crisis at a Philadelphia concert.

stories.title: Duitsers opgepakt voor ophangen van nepkunst in het Louvre

en.title: Germans arrested for hanging fake art in the Louvre
en.summary: Two German men were arrested in Paris after hanging fake paintings they created on the wall in the Louvre's Mona Lisa gallery. The museum reported minor wall damage and the men claimed the act was intended as a prank.

stories.title: Trump wil ontwikkeling van AI versnellen en kondigt ‘AI Force’ aan

en.title: Trump wants to accelerate AI development and announces 'AI Force'
en.summary: President Trump announced plans to establish a special artificial intelligence unit called the AI Force and will appoint an AI advisor. The initiative aims to accelerate AI development and address potential negative consequences of the technology.

stories.title: Twee Duitsers opgepakt voor ophangen van nepkunstwerken in Louvre

en.title: Two Germans arrested for hanging fake artwork in Louvre
en.summary: French police arrested two German men in Paris for using tape to hang fake artworks in the Louvre's gallery containing the Mona Lisa.

stories.title: Witte Huis weert verslaggevers van CNN, MS NOW en Politico na verbod van Trump

en.title: White House bars reporters from CNN, MSNBC and Politico following Trump ban
en.summary: Journalists from CNN, MSNBC, and Politico were denied access to the White House today, a measure announced by President Trump the previous day. Trump cited coverage he deemed unfavorable as the reason for the action.

stories.title: CNN staat voor een dichte deur van het Witte Huis, volgens Trump produceert de zender voortdurend ‘fictie en leugens’

en.title: CNN faces closed door at White House; Trump says network produces 'fiction and lies'
en.summary: President Trump has restricted CNN's access to the White House, characterizing the network's reporting as producing false information.

stories.title: Trump voegt daad bij het woord: eerste journalisten geweerd uit Witte Huis

en.title: Trump follows through: first journalists barred from White House
en.summary: The White House denied access to journalists from CNN, MSNBC, and Politico on Saturday, following President Donald Trump's Friday announcement that these outlets would no longer be welcome.
